notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deranged Hermit, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Deranged Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Deranged Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm four times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
